_note: Eight canonical singularity milestones. Each agent updates p_at_target daily based on evidence movement on the 8 SP-Index dimensions. Tiny moves (typical day) nudge 1–2pp. Big moves (rare day) swing more, justified in prose. When Claude and Codex disagree by >5pp on a single day's update, BOTH numbers render in the issue's COUNTDOWNS section.

countdowns.name: AGI · METR 1-month autonomy
countdowns.tagline: AI completes 1-month tasks at 50% human reliability

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — METR last published Q1 2026 with ~1h horizon, doubling time ~5.7mo → 1mo by mid-2028 is plausible-not-certain
Anthropic ships autonomous-agents preview AT the memory wall (LongMemEval-V2 + MEME show <5% dependency reasoning). Slight negative nudge on autonomy-horizon.
Meta capex $115–135B = compute substrate for capacity-side AGI work. Reverses yesterday's nudge.

Dan McAteer thread surfaces Mythos past METR's 16h measurable ceiling — METR's own caveat that measurements above 16h are unreliable means we don't know exactly where the 50% time-horizon lands, but it's substantially past 16h, not the 1h baseline. AISI cyber doubling 8mo→4.7mo (super-exponential) is independent corroboration. Bigger-than-typical +5pp move; flagged in dialogue. Uncertainty caveat: McAteer is synthesis, not raw data; await independent confirmation of the METR-16h claim.
Mythos at 17.4h p50 is 2.2× the AI 2027 scenario midpoint, 3 months early. +2pp. Reliability gap at p80 keeps it from a bigger swing.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: METR or successor benchmark publishes a 50%-completion result on a curated set of 1-month-wall-clock tasks with no human intervention beyond setup.

countdowns.name: RSI · AI trains AI better than humans
countdowns.tagline: AI-designed training run beats human-designed at frontier scale

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — Anthropic's automated-alignment-research signal (Import AI #454) + AlphaEvolve scale-out point in this direction, but no public training-run yet shows clear AI-designed > human-designed at frontier scale
Learning Fast-and-Slow paper (Zaharia/Keutzer/Gonzalez/Dhillon) reduces forgetting in RL fine-tuning by ~70% KL — makes continual learning cheaper, RSI loop cheaper.
AEvo (DeepWisdom + HKUST) — meta-agent editing the agent-evolution procedure. Clean precursor pattern for RSI. +1pp.
Prime Intellect Auto-NanoGPT shows Codex + Claude Code optimizing themselves at 14k H200-hours, beating human nanoGPT baseline. RSI loop is concrete now. +1pp.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: A frontier-tier model (top-5 on LMArena) is publicly attributed to an AI-designed training pipeline (data mix, hyperparams, architecture choice), with the lab acknowledging the AI's contribution exceeded the humans-in-loop.

countdowns.name: Country of Geniuses (Amodei)
countdowns.tagline: Datacenters running millions of Nobel-laureate-equivalent AI workers

p_history.evidence: Meta $115–135B 2026 capex provides the compute substrate Amodei's framing requires. Reversing yesterday's -1 nudge.
Memory wall papers — agent autonomy bottleneck identified. -1pp (later acknowledged in dialogue as the wrong read).

v8 baseline — Amodei framed his ~18-month window in Jan 2026, target ≈ mid-2027. 25% reflects: capability composite trending fast (GPQA 94, SWE-bench-Pro 64, autonomy 1h) BUT no public deployment yet at the scale he described.
OpenAI Deployment Co. $4B + 150 FDEs + 19-investor consortium puts deployment surface at scenario-level scale. +1pp.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: A major lab publicly confirms running a population of AI agents at frontier-Nobel-laureate-equivalent capability on real research/economic tasks at scale (≥10k parallel instances doing independent novel work).

countdowns.name: ASI · superintelligence
countdowns.tagline: AI exceeds top human experts across every domain

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — broader claim than AGI. Currently no domain where AI demonstrably exceeds top human experts on novel work (vs. benchmark performance). 2030 horizon plausible if RSI lands first.
Held at 22%. Same-week meltdown of both frontier code-agents argues against runaway timelines.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: Peer-reviewed evidence that an AI system measurably exceeds top human expert performance on novel research tasks (not just benchmark performance) across 5+ disparate domains.

countdowns.name: Vinge Singularity (2030 baseline)

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — Vinge's 'between 2005 and 2030' framing. Probability low because the strict 'fall of the human era' framing is uncalibrated; loose readings (transformative AI) overlap with AGI/ASI countdowns above.
Held at 10%. No movement on strict-definition window.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: Subjective — broad consensus among AI safety researchers + policymakers that the post-Vinge era has begun. Track community sentiment surveys; resolve when ≥70% of named-researcher surveys agree.

countdowns.name: Kurzweil Singularity (2045)

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — Kurzweil's 2045 has a 19-year runway from today. Given current curve velocity, >50% probability is reasonable, but the specific definition (merger of biological + digital intelligence) is harder to operationalize than AGI/ASI.
Held at 55%. 19-year runway — daily noise doesn't move long-horizon estimate.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: Combined human-AI cognition becomes the default mode of frontier intellectual work (BCI bandwidth + AI co-cognition deployed at >1M people scale, with measurable capability gains).

countdowns.name: First robotic Turing test pass
countdowns.tagline: Humanoid indistinguishable from human at a physical task

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — Figure 02 at BMW (5mm precision, 1250 hrs) + Physical Intelligence π0.7 + Skild Brain suggest the embodied-foundation-model stack is closing fast. 2029 horizon = 3.5 years; current capability gap is bigger than the AI Turing gap was 3 years pre-ChatGPT.
Figure F.03 8h public shift + Boston Dynamics + DeepMind Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6 = embodied stack closing faster than expected. +5pp jump.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: Humanoid completes a physical task (assembly, navigation, manipulation, social interaction) in a blind, time-bounded setting peer-witnessed by ≥3 independent observers who cannot distinguish from a human at the same task.

countdowns.name: AI co-authors Nature paper as primary author
countdowns.tagline: Editorial endorsement of an AI as first/corresponding author

p_history.evidence: v8 baseline — AlphaEvolve scale-out, Thinking Machines' Interaction Models post, and Anthropic's automated-alignment-research direction all point at AI-doing-science crossing into recognizable research output. Nature specifically (not just preprints) is a hard gate; 2028 plausible.
Prime Intellect Auto-NanoGPT (AI-designed training runs beating human baseline) is the closest precursor to AI-as-primary-author published this year. +3pp.

countdowns.resolution_criteria: Nature accepts a paper with an AI system listed as first or corresponding author, with the journal's editorial endorsement of the attribution. Preprints, lab whitepapers, and co-author lists with AI buried below human authors do NOT count.
